certification: symplectic propagation of the measured Z back through each CNOT list; the resulting support must EQUAL the intended check support -- not a subset, not a superset

schedule.note: greedy conflict-free layering; an upper bound from one heuristic, not a claimed optimum

baseline: 864 CNOTs = sum of check weights, what the code's own connectivity achieves (Bravyi et al. schedule); the ratio is against that
scope: two-qubit gate count on a degree-3 model lattice; no crosstalk, leakage or control-stack constraints -- each of those makes a real device worse, so this ratio is a LOWER BOUND on true overhead
